definitions.explanation: The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the shoulder and the elbow. More technical than {二|に}の{腕|うで}, the everyday word for the same area.

examples.japanese: {上腕|じょうわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きたえる。
⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上腕|じょうわん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Injections are often given in the upper arm.

examples.japanese: {上腕|じょうわん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{力|ちから}こぶ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The upper arm contains the muscle that forms the biceps bulge.

notes:
The anatomical term for the part of the arm between the shoulder and the elbow. Used in medical and fitness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上腕|じょうわん}{二頭筋|にとうきん}: biceps
- {上腕|じょうわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: upper-arm muscles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二|に}の{腕|うで}→二の腕：06437_ninoude⟧: upper arm — everyday, non-technical term
- ⟦{前腕|ぜんわん}→前腕：29743_zenwan⟧: forearm — the part below the elbow
